hints.tr: Önce müşteri toplamlarını bir ada bağla: `WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(...) AS total ... GROUP BY o.customer_id)`.
hints.en: First bind the customer totals to a name: `WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(...) AS total ... GROUP BY o.customer_id)`.

hints.tr: Aynı ad hem `FROM`'da hem ortalamada kullanılabiliyor: `ct.total - (SELECT AVG(total) FROM customer_totals)`. Adı almak için `customers` ile birleştir.
hints.en: The same name can be used both in `FROM` and for the average: `ct.total - (SELECT AVG(total) FROM customer_totals)`. Join `customers` to get the name.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS total
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT c.name, ct.total,
       ct.total - (SELECT AVG(total) FROM customer_totals) AS vs_avg
FROM customer_totals ct
JOIN customers c ON c.id = ct.customer_id
ORDER BY ct.total DESC;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS total
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT c.name, ct.total,
       ct.total - (SELECT AVG(total) FROM customer_totals) AS vs_avg
FROM customer_totals ct
JOIN customers c ON c.id = ct.customer_id
ORDER BY ct.total DESC;
```

hint.tr: Bu bölüm `WITH` çalıştırıyor: ara sonucu `WITH ad AS (...)` ile adlandır.
hint.en: This section practises `WITH`: name the intermediate result with `WITH name AS (...)`.
